svg.title: Chinese Provinces
svg.desc: Made with Natural Earth · Admin 1 states and provinces, repository release v5.1.2. Public domain — https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/. Hong Kong districts dissolved; source Paracel Islands grouped with Hainan; English names; Albers projection; coordinate rounding; shared-border SVG; simplified thumbnail; small-target circles. Preview geometry simplified. Reference rivers: Natural Earth, public domain, repository release v5.1.2. Lake outline (2022): Sun et al. (2026), Dataset of typical terminal lake and surrounding oasis outlines in arid/semi-arid endorheic basins based on remote sensing data. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.29899274. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Converted all 300 lake polygons from WGS84 shapefile to GeoJSON, preserving every coordinate and hole; reversed ring winding to GeoJSON convention. No oasis polygons included. The 2022 outline is a dated snapshot of a variable terminal lake.
